title: The record of Caddy's drop-in (/var/lib/velexis/caddy-dropin.sha256)
caption: deploy.sh activate_caddyfile and provision-vm.sh restart_caddy (lead decision (22b)). A deploy restarts Caddy when the installed drop-in differs from this record and the service runs the Velexis build.

states.label: no record (VM provisioned before 22b)
states.detail: The deploy compares with the drop-in installed when it began, then writes the record.

states.label: <SHA-256> (or none)
states.detail: The drop-in Caddy was last (re)started with.

states.label: restarting
states.detail: Written before `systemctl restart caddy`; stays if the restart fails or the run is cut off, so the next deploy restarts again.

transitions.label: build or drop-in changed → restart begins
Caddyfile or waf only → reload, record unchanged
